name: Jushab-hesed
overview: Jushab-hesed was a male member of the tribe of Judah, known primarily as the son of Meshullam. His identity is succinctly recorded in 1 Chronicles 3:20, with no additional personal details or narrative provided in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Jushab-hesed means 'loyal love will be returned.' This proper name, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 3:20, reflects a meaningful Hebrew expression but was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Jushab-hesed as the son of Meshullam, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Beyond this, no further family connections or relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Jushab-hesed's significance lies in his placement within the genealogical records of the tribe of Judah, as preserved in 1 Chronicles 3:20. His mention contributes to the biblical lineage that traces the heritage of God's chosen people, underscoring the faithfulness of God's promises through successive generations.
